במקום תחזית לעיר – תחזית לנקודת הלינה (ט: Instead of a city forecast – a forecast for the sleeping spot (minimum temperature, wind, rain) for every night in the plan, with an alert 'below 5 degrees – warm sleeping bag' or 'wind 40 km/h – don't pitch a tent on the ridge'.
חנויות/מכולות/קיבוצים לאורך השביל עם שעו: Shops/grocery stores/kibbutzim along the trail with opening hours and distance from the trail line; calculation of 'food days until the next resupply' and weight distribution; shopping list by days. HiiKER shows amenities but without calculation.
מדידת קצב אמיתי בימים הראשונים ועדכון או: Measuring real pace in the first days and automatically updating the rest of the itinerary (campsites, angels, caches) when running a day behind/ahead – 'push everything by one day' in one tap, including updating angel reminders.
האפליקציה הייעודית היחידה לשביל ישראל שנ: The only dedicated Israel Trail app found in the stores. Strong in offline navigation and basic logistical information (water, campsites, angels), weak in advance planning, calculations (water/heat/daylight) and journaling.
סימון מקטעים ששונו/נסגרו (למשל ביטול מקט: Marking sections that were changed/closed (e.g. cancellation of section 1 in 2021, opening of Hermon–Banias and Zichron–Ramat HaNadiv) with date and source (SPNI), so as not to rely on old GPX – a recurring complaint in the INT app and on Wikiloc.
לכל יום: זמן הליכה משוער (מרחק, טיפוס, ק: For each day: estimated walking time (distance, climb, measured personal pace) versus sunset/twilight – shows the last safe departure time and the 'margin' in minutes; in the field it updates by actual pace and alerts when daylight runs out before the campsite.
מסך חירום שמציג נ.צ. ברשת ישראל החדשה וב: Emergency screen showing coordinates in the New Israel Grid and WGS84, elevation, the section and the wadi name, with buttons for MDA 101, rescue unit, INPA, and an SMS template (works without data too). Connects to the 'emergency wifi for hikers' initiative.
בסוף יום: תמונה אחת עם מפה, ק\"מ, טיפוס,: At the end of the day: one image with map, km, climb, time, photos from the journal, weather and 'day X of Y' – for sharing on WhatsApp/Instagram; and at the finish – a digital completion certificate with the trip data (Arad→Eilat, 1,000+ km).
כרטיס קבוע במסך השטח: ק\"מ, טיפוס וזמן מ: A fixed card on the field screen: km, climb and estimated time to the next water point, to the planned overnight campsite, to the nearest angel and to the rescue/road point. The INT app gives 'distance to tap'; we add all the rest from the sections database.
מצב שטח מינימלי (מסך שחור, GPS בדגימה נמ: Minimal field mode (black screen, low-rate GPS sampling, voice warnings only), an energy display 'how many hours left', and export of the day's route to Garmin/Apple Watch (FIT/GPX) – the common complaint in the INT app and Amud Anan.
ביצירת איטינררי: זיהוי אוטומטי של שישי/ש: When creating an itinerary: automatic detection of Friday/Shabbat and holidays, a suggestion to finish in a town/at an angel's before Shabbat begins (start/end times by location), alerts about closed shops and non-running public transport, and a 'rest day' option.
מהתוכנית היומית בדרום (ערד–אילת) נגזרות: From the daily plan in the south (Arad–Eilat) the cache points are derived, the number of litres for each and the arrival date; output as a ready WhatsApp message for the supplier/angel (name, campsite, quantity, date, phone). There is no tool for this today – it's all in forums.
חישוב אוטומטי של צריכת מים לכל יום בתוכנ: Automatic calculation of water consumption for every day in the plan: distance × pace × forecast temperature × cumulative climb, with a recommendation of how much to carry and how much to cache, and an alert when the need exceeds 6–7 litres. No app calculates this – they all just mark 'there's water here'.
סימון מקטעים שעוברים בנחלים (צאלים, צין,: Marking sections that pass through wadis (Tze'elim, Zin, Barak, Paran, Hava, Arugot) with a red/orange flag when the forecast shows rain in the catchment area (even far from the hiker) in winter, and suggesting an alternative section/waiting. An explicit user request on Amud Anan that was never implemented.
